name: project-nomad
description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.

issues.title: [Bug]: Auto context window floors gemma4:12b to 4096 on a 12 GB GPU, so RAG chunks are silently dropped
[Bug]: Knowledge Base indexes only HTML entries of a ZIM, so the PDF-based curated tiers (Medical Library, Military Medicine, Water, Food, Knots, Post Disaster) give the AI 1–2 chunks each
[Bug]: nomad_admin Docker log grew to ~1 GB and filled root filesystem
install: preflight host mounts, management ports, and existing state before creating NOMAD resources
[Bug]: ZIM ingestion is O(n²) — every batch re-scans the archive from entry 0, making large ZIMs unfinishable
[Bug]: Indexing a ZIM that ships machine translations (WikEM: 95.6% of its articles) embeds every language, so an "eng" ZIM costs ~25x the disk and time and fills retrieval with non-English chunks

discussions.title: Heybe — a USB-stick take on the NOMAD idea, inspired by your project
Project NOMAD — Raspberry Pi 5 / Ubuntu ARM64 Fork
For NOMAD curated content: emergency reference document per country
[Bug]: AI Models catalog falls back to three models when estimated_pulls is null
WSL2 guide: the installer never sets up the NVIDIA Container Toolkit under WSL, so the AI Assistant silently runs on CPU

latest_release.name: v1.35.1
latest_release.body:
## Version 1.35.1 - October 5, 2026

### Features
### Bug Fixes
- **AI**: probe a model the list reports without vision before disabling image attachments, so `gemma3` accepts images again (#1409). Thanks @chriscrosstalk for the contribution!
- **Translate**: forward upstream redirects instead of following them, so books open styled and their article links resolve (#1379). Thanks @chriscrosstalk for the contribution!
- **Translate**: download every released language instead of crashing on pre-release models, and list all supported languages in the docs (#1405). Thanks @chriscrosstalk for the contribution!
### Improvements

---

### 📝 All Changes
